notes: Relative paths only; run from the campaign root on the bench (Raspberry Pi 5 'devin'), uut/ = this repository with submodules, built natively (fprime-util generate && fprime-util build in uut/SunCamRef). flash installs {image} as {rundir}/SunCamRef, stops the previous instance by its recorded PID ({rundir}/SunCamRef.pid) and starts the new one (cwd {rundir}: PrmDb.dat and DpCat live there), logging install/read-back sha256 to {rundir}/flash.log. dump copies the running binary to {readback} and the DpWriter directory {rundir}/DpCat into dp/ beside it (record/raw/dp/). reset restarts by recorded PID and settles >= 3 s. Only /dev/ttyUSB0 (the FTDI RS-422 cable) and the recorded PID are touched; never pkill/pgrep by pattern.
